净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Measures smoothness of daily price action by comparing return magnitude to high-low range. Low ratio indicates the close is near the midpoint (choppy/smooth), high ratio indicates strong directional movement. Negative rolling average assigns high values to periods of smooth, consistent pricing, aligning with temporal stability.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ 已翻转（IC<0）⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

-ts_mean(20, (close/ts_delay(close)-1)^2 / (high-low)^2)
依赖列: open, high, low, close, volume

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-ts_mean(20, (close/ts_delay(close)-1)^2 / (high-low)^2)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(divide(power(subtract(divide(close, ts_delay(close)), 1), 2), power(subtract(high, low), 2)), 20)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(power(subtract(divide(close, ts_delay(close)), 1), 2), power(subtract(high, low), 2))
  3. 3. power —— 取幂(乘方)
    power(subtract(divide(close, ts_delay(close)), 1), 2)
  4. 4. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(close, ts_delay(close)), 1)
  5. 5. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(close, ts_delay(close))
  6. 6. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(close)
  7. 7. power —— 取幂(乘方)
    power(subtract(high, low), 2)
  8. 8. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(high, low)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
power计算 x 的 y 次方

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 daily_ret：close / close.shift(1) - 1
  2. 计算 daily_range：high - low
  3. 计算 smoothness_ratio：(daily_ret ** 2) / (daily_range ** 2)
  4. 计算 avg_ratio：smoothness_ratio.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=10).mean()
  5. 计算 factor：-avg_ratio
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_price_smoothness(df): df_copy = df.copy() "com"># Daily "kw">class="kw">return magnitude relative to intraday range daily_ret = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(1) - 1 daily_range = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"] "com"># Ratio of squared "kw">class="kw">return to squared range; small when price moves smoothly within range smoothness_ratio = (daily_ret ** 2) / (daily_range ** 2).replace(0, np.nan) "com"># Rolling average of smoothness ratio over 20 days avg_ratio = smoothness_ratio.rolling(20, min_periods=10).mean() "com"># Negative so high factor = smooth factor = -avg_ratio df_copy["factor_price_smoothness"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_price_smoothness"]
